name: B300 (Blackwell Ultra, GB300 NVL72 variant)
notes: Same 'Blackwell Ultra' silicon as b300-sxm-hgx.json, but binned to a higher power/thermal envelope (1400W vs 1100W) when deployed in the liquid-cooled GB300 NVL72 rack, yielding higher memory capacity (279GB vs 270GB), bandwidth (8 vs 7.7 TB/s), and compute across every Tensor Core precision. FP8 and FP6 published as a single combined figure by NVIDIA (shared tensor core datapath) -- both fields carry the same source value. Dense figures not independently published; NVIDIA footnote states dense = sparse / 2, not recorded here since that would be a derived, not sourced, value.

_sources.process_node_nm: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-blackwell-ultra-the-chip-powering-the-ai-factory-era/ ('Blackwell Ultra is manufactured using TSMC 4NP'; side-by-side table confirms same TSMC 4NP as B200)
